Three 256x256 crops and their keypoint labels from the validation split of the Glasses-in-the-Wild dataset
(Adriaens, Lips, De Coster, Verleysen, wyffels; Ghent University), https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17288314,
licensed CC BY 4.0. Unmodified; `keypoints.json` holds the four structural keypoints from the dataset's
`annotations.json`.
